faq.question: How do you decide what to build first?
faq.answer: We map every idea against impact, feasibility, and effort, then prototype the riskiest assumption within the first few days so early progress proves the direction, not just fills a timeline.

faq.question: What does the workflow look like once we start?
faq.answer: A dedicated design + engineering pair works from a shared board you have full visibility into. Decisions get logged inline, so you're never chasing an update in a separate thread.

faq.question: Can you work with our existing stack or design system?
faq.answer: Yes we map your existing tokens, components, and build steps into our process from day one. Where a gap shows up, we patch it with tests so speed never comes at the cost of consistency.

faq.question: How is quality checked before launch?
faq.answer: Accessibility passes, visual regression checks, and performance budgets run on every merge. Nothing ships until it holds up on real devices, not just in a preview link.

faq.question: How long does a typical project take?
faq.answer: A focused marketing site usually lands in 3–5 weeks; a full web app is closer to 8–14 depending on scope. You'll get a clear milestone plan before any work begins, not a vague estimate.

faq.question: What happens after launch?
faq.answer: Every project rolls into a maintenance window by default monitoring, security patches, and small fixes are covered, with clear options if you want an ongoing retainer beyond that.
